name: MF-80
description: MF-80 was Gardulla Besadii the Elder's protocol droid during the Clone Wars. When Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos went to Nal Hutta in order to talk to the Hutt Grand Council, MF-80 was present and translated the conversation between her master and the two Jedi. Her metal plating had a two-color scheme.
